market_definition: The MENA Magnesium Glycinate Market covers magnesium glycinate supplements and finished formulations containing magnesium glycinate as an active nutritional ingredient. The market includes powder, capsules, tablets, softgels, gummies, oral solutions, liquids, and sachets, along with single-ingredient and combination formulations used for magnesium supplementation, general wellness, sleep and relaxation, stress management, muscle health, women's health, sports recovery, and other nutritional applications across the Middle East and North Africa. By Product Type: Powder, Capsules, Tablets, Softgels, Gummies, Oral Solutions & Liquids, Sachets, Other. By Formulation Type: Single-Ingredient; + Vitamins; + Minerals; + Herbal/Botanical; + Amino Acids; Multi-Magnesium; Other Combinations. By Application: Magnesium Deficiency, Bone & Muscle Health, Sleep & Relaxation, Stress & Mood, Cardiovascular, Energy & Metabolism, Nervous System, Women's Health, Sports Performance & Recovery, Healthy Aging, General Wellness, Other. By End User: General Adults, Elderly, Women, Athletes, Magnesium-Deficient Individuals, Sleep & Stress Consumers, Patients, Health-Conscious Consumers, Other. By Dosage: Low, Standard, High. By Distribution Channel: Retail Pharmacies, Hospital & Institutional Pharmacies, Clinics, E-Commerce, Health & Wellness Stores, Supermarkets & Hypermarkets, Specialty Nutrition Stores, Direct-to-Consumer, Other. By Region: GCC (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain); Levant (Egypt, Morocco); North Africa (Algeria, Libya, Sudan, Tunisia, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen). EXCLUDED from the market: magnesium supplements without magnesium glycinate (except for benchmarking); other magnesium salts sold standalone; general vitamins, minerals and supplements unrelated to magnesium glycinate; food, beverage and cosmetic products; pharmaceuticals without magnesium glycinate; upstream raw materials and ingredient intermediates; other finished supplements without magnesium glycinate. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - SPECIALTY NUTRACEUTICAL DISTRIBUTOR: a pharmaceutical / nutraceutical distributor, importer or wholesaler headquartered in the MENA countries above that distributes finished dietary-supplement brands including magnesium glycinate products (e.g. NOW Foods, Doctor's Best, Thorne, Solgar, Nature Made, Pure Encapsulations, Life Extension, Nature's Bounty, Garden of Life) to pharmacies, hospitals, clinics and retailers - as in the report's distributor group (Ibnsina Pharma, Tamer Group, Banaja, Salehiya, Fattal, Cigalah, Dallah, Kettaneh, Mersaco, Promedic, Ubipharm, AMCO). EXCLUDED companies: supplement brand owners and finished product manufacturers, raw-material and ingredient suppliers, pharmacy chains, retailers and e-commerce stores, and companies headquartered outside these MENA countries.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
